market_name: Will 10 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market's implied probability of many cuts actually moved sharply vs. thin-book noise; cross-check 2Y/10Y Treasury futures for confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Confirm move in fed funds futures (SOFR/Fed funds curve) and any macro headline (jobs, credit stress, geopolitical shock) that could justify aggressive easing bets.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether TLT is tracking the rates repricing or diverging; look for term-premium vs. flight-to-safety drivers.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate against equity/credit stress signals (HYG, VIX); a genuine easing-repricing should coincide with risk-off.
time_plan.12h: Mark realized TLT return vs. expectation; determine if signal reflected new information or reverted (mean-reversion suggests noise).

predictions.reasoning: A market implying 10 Fed cuts (~250bps of easing) in 2026 is a deep-easing/recession-or-emergency scenario. A sharp rise in that implied probability would signal expectations of a much lower policy path, which mechanically pulls front-end and belly yields down and, on flight-to-safety, long yields too — pushing long-duration bond ETFs like TLT higher. But this is a far tail; a 12h probability jump is a noisy, low-signal event.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check S&P futures and VIX for corroborating risk-off; verify the prediction-market move is real, not a stale quote.
time_plan.1h: Look for a triggering catalyst (credit event, geopolitical shock, weak data) that would justify both easing bets and equity weakness.
time_plan.2h: Assess breadth and whether defensives outperform cyclicals, consistent with a recession-easing narrative.
time_plan.6h: Re-check whether equities are reading the easing as relief (rally) or as a growth scare (selloff); adjust directional read.
time_plan.12h: Record realized SPY return; note if the equity reaction confirmed or contradicted the recession interpretation of the rate-cut signal.

predictions.reasoning: Ten cuts in a single year is not a soft-landing story — it implies a sharp downturn, financial stress, or emergency intercutting. If that probability spiked, it would typically accompany risk-off equity selling (growth scare outweighing the 'Fed put' relief). However the sign is ambiguous: markets sometimes rally on aggressive-easing hopes, so direction is genuinely uncertain and confidence is low.

evidence_used: Market resolves on count of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026, including emergency intermeeting cuts
10 cuts implies ~250bps of easing, far beyond baseline soft-landing expectations
Deep-easing scenarios historically coincide with recession/financial-stress regimes
Standard rates-transmission: lower expected policy path lifts bond prices and pressures risk assets
uncertainty_notes: A 12h window is far too short to resolve a full-year cut count; any probability move is a weak, noisy sensor
Equity direction is genuinely ambiguous (Fed-put relief rally vs. growth-scare selloff)
700bps tradability threshold is unrealistic for these liquid proxies in 12h — neither prediction is 'tradable' by that bar
Prediction-market liquidity for extreme-tail strikes is typically thin, so implied-probability moves can be quote artifacts

llm_justification.summary: The market prices an extreme tail: 10 Fed cuts (~250bps easing) in 2026, which only occurs in recession/emergency regimes. A sharp rise in that implied probability would map to lower rates (long Treasuries/TLT up) and, most likely but ambiguously, risk-off equities (SPY down). Both mappings are directionally plausible but low-confidence over a 12h window, and neither is expected to clear the 700bps move bar; treat the prediction market as a noisy, low-signal sensor here.
key_assumptions: A meaningful, real (non-noise) jump in the many-cuts probability actually occurs
The easing scenario is interpreted as recession/stress rather than benign
Rates and equity proxies respond within the 12h window rather than lagging
failure_modes: The probability move is thin-book noise or a stale quote, not information
Equities rally on 'Fed put' easing hopes rather than selling off, flipping the SPY sign
The macro backdrop is already public (priced in), so no fresh asset move follows
TLT is a weak proxy if the repricing is concentrated in the front end (SHY/2Y) rather than long duration
Mean-reversion: an intraday spike reverses by the 12h mark
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
